headline: Food chains show energy flow—from sun to plant to herbivore to predator
universal_truth: Everything is connected through what it consumes; you are what you eat, literally
fun_facts: Only about 10% of energy transfers from one level to the next—most is lost as heat
Top predators are rare because so much energy is lost by the time it reaches them
The DDT pesticide accumulated up food chains, nearly killing off bald eagles at the top
discussion_questions: Where are you in the food chain of your industry or field?

hook.script: The sun feeds the grass. The grass feeds the rabbit. The rabbit feeds the fox. Energy flows from source to consumer to consumer—this is a food chain. Every creature is connected to every other through what eats what.

cliff.script: Food chains seem simple, but they reveal deep truths about energy, connection, and position. What do they teach us?

options.text: Food chains show that everything depends on what's below it—energy and matter flow through connections; position determines what you can access
options.response: Yes. Where you are in the chain determines your energy sources and vulnerabilities. Understanding chains reveals dependencies and strategic positions.

options.text: They just show what animals eat
options.response: Eating patterns, yes, but also energy flow, dependencies, and system vulnerabilities...

fact1.title: Energy Loss
fact1.script: Only 10% of energy transfers up each level—90% is lost as heat. That's why there are many plants, fewer herbivores, and even fewer predators. Scarcity at the top is built into physics.

fact2.title: Chain Dependencies
fact2.script: Remove a link and the chain breaks. If plants die, herbivores starve, then predators starve. Dependencies cascade. What you depend on matters; protect your supply chain.

fact3.title: Your Position
fact3.script: You're in food chains too—information chains, value chains, supply chains. Where you sit determines what you access and what depends on you. Position is strategic.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Everything is connected through what it consumes. You are what you eat—literally. Understand your chains and dependencies.

outro.script: That's Day 255. Tomorrow, we'll explore nature's connected eating—food webs. Until then, map your position in one of your chains.

growTrack.title: Chain Mapping - Where Are You?
growTrack.activity: Pick a 'chain' you're part of—information, value, supply, influence. What feeds into you? What do you feed into? Where are you positioned? Understanding your chain reveals dependencies and opportunities.
